#!/bin/bash
# TK-298: closes с монетой для Г-134 — portfolio-sim cap0 по готовым деревьям ps/b (без нового busy-replay), --closes-sym-out.
W=/data/tk0274/g134-psim; O=/data/tk0298/g134sym; T=/data/tk0113/tools; C=/data/tk0274/g134-r1/cells
mkdir -p $O; cd $O; rm -f sym.done sym-fail.txt
one() { mo=$1; lab=2026-$2; form=$(cat $W/ps/form-$mo.txt); args=()
  for cf in $C/$lab/*.csv; do c=$(basename $cf .csv); grep -qx "$c" $W/ps/empty-$mo.txt && continue; args+=(--variant "$c=$c/$form"); done
  python3 $T/portfolio-sim.py --epoch "$lab=$W/ps/b:$lab" "${args[@]}" --deposit-usd 2500 --position-usd 500 --max-pos 0 \
    --closes-sym-out closes-sym-g134-cap0-$mo.json > psim-sym-$mo.txt 2> psim-sym-$mo.log || echo "FAIL $mo" >> sym-fail.txt; }
export -f one; export W O T C
printf '%s\n' "jan 01" "feb 02" "mar 03" "apr 04" "may 05" "jun 06" "jul 07" "aug 08" "sep 09" | xargs -P 3 -L1 bash -c 'one $0 $1'
[ -e sym-fail.txt ] || touch sym.done
EOF
scp /tmp/g134sym.sh calc:/tmp/g134sym.sh && ssh calc 'sed -i "s/\r$//" /tmp/g134sym.sh; mkdir -p /data/tk0298; cp /tmp/g134sym.sh /data/tk0298/g134sym.sh; systemd-run --unit=tk298-g134sym --collect --property=CPUQuota=300% bash /data/tk0298/g134sym.sh; sleep 45; ls /data/tk0298/g134sym; cat /data/tk0298/g134sym/sym-fail.txt 2>&1'
